content: Jesús, Pilato-abin gwichid

Wakudaryalaba, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, Judíoʼmar-girmar-dummaganmala, Garda-Narmaked-Dulemarmala, degi, Judío-dummagan-igar-nabiromaladmala igar-amismalad. Igar-itoged-bergusgua, Jesús-edichamalad. Geb Jesús-sesmalad, degi, Pilatoʼga Jesús-ukdapmalad.
Geb Pilato Jesúsʼse egichided: —¿Ar be, Judíoʼmar-E-Rey? Jesús, abin-imaksad: —Ar be-sunnad soged.
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan Jesús ibmar-isgana-imakdiiye egi sognanai guarmalad.
Pilato gannar Jesúsʼse egichided: —¿Be dulemar-abin imakosuli? Be dake, bule begi sognanai, bede ibmar-isgana imakdiiye.
Ar Jesúsʼdi amba gwen bipisaale abin-imaksasurbalid. Degisoggu, Pilato geger daksunnad.
Jesúsʼga burgwed-igar-megisad
Ibagine, gusgu Pilato Judíoʼmar-egismaladba dule-wargwen-esgaryagi-mellesiid ega onodaed.
Agine, deun dule-wargwen, Barrabásʼye-nugad, e-sordamarmala esgaryagi mellesiid. Amar Roma-dulemargi-gwisgusmargu, dulemar-oburgwis gusmalad.
Dulemar-bukidar Pilatoʼse nonimalad. Geb ese egisnonimalad, igi gusgu dule-wargwen-esgaryagi-mellesiid onodae, deyob ega onobarye.
Pilato dulemar-abin sogded: —¿Bemarga Judíoʼmar-E-Rey onobi be an-abemala?
Ar ade, Pilato magar-daksad, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan binsa-Jesúsʼgi-nobedba ega uksamala.
Ar dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagandi, dulemar-oimakega imaksamalad, adi, dulemar Pilatoʼse egisega, ega bur Barrabás onoye.
Pilato dulemarse gannar egisdebalid: —¿Judíoʼmar-E-Reyye bemar biedi, igi imakbi be an-abemarsunna?
Dulemar, Pilato-abin-oimakdemalad: —¡Nakrusgi bioke!
Pilato, dulemar-abin-sogded: —¿Ibigala? ¿Ar we-dulede ibu-ibmar-isgana imaksasunna? Ar dulemar bur bule oimakdemalad, sogdemalad: —¡Nakrusgi bioke!
Ar Pilato nabir-dulemar-ito-imakbisoggu, ega Barrabás onossunnad. Geb Jesús-bibyosad-sorba, suar-ibmalaga Jesús-uksad, adi, nakrusgi bioknamalagar.
Suar-ibmala Jesúsʼgi dodosmalad
Geb degine, suar-ibmala Pilato-neg-Pretorioʼye-nugad-imbase Jesús-sesmalad. Agi suar-ibmala, bela-e-sordamar-danagwenad oambikusmalad.
Jesúsʼga mor-suir-akwagiid yosmalad. Geb sorbali, gurgin-ikobiid sobsamalad, geb Jesús-nonogi sismalad.
Geb Jesúsʼgi dododmalad, binnasur gotemalad: “¡Judíoʼmar-E-Rey, be-nug dummarba gusunna!”
Suargi Jesús-nono-sarsonanai, degi, egi wiaknanai gusmalad. Jesús-nug-odummogega yamo Jesús-abin yokorgi-sindigar signonidamalad.
Suar-ibgan Jesúsʼgi-dodosmalad-sorba, e-ibe mor-suir-akwagiid esusmalad, geb e-mor ega gannar yosmalad. Geb neggi Jesús-onosmalad, adi, nakrusgi bioknamalagar.
Jesús nakrusgi bioklesad
Suar-ibgan igarba Jesús-semaigu, dule-wargwen Cireneʼgined Simónʼye-nugad sapurba-gudidaniki dakarmalad. A-dulede, Alejandro-e-babad, degi, Rufo-e-babad. Suar-ibgan a-dule nakrus-seega imaksamalad.
Deyobi suar-ibgan Gólgotaʼye-neg-nugadse Jesús-sesmalad. Gólgota sogleged, Dule-Nonogar-Negye.
Agi Jesúsʼga vino ina-gagbid-oburaled uksamalad, adi, Jesús mer dogdar nunmaked-itogegar. Ar Jesúsʼdi gobsasulid.
Geb suar-ibgan nakrusgi Jesús-bioksamalad. Jesús-mor siir-siir imaksamalad. Geb dodoar wilubdaknai-guarmalad, Jesús-mor-igid na emargadga guodibeye.
Wakdar-wachi-ilabakebaki, nakrusgi Jesús-bioksamalad.
E-nakrus-birgi narmaksamalad, ibiga Jesús burgwenai. Narmakaled weyob sognaid: We-Jesús Judíoʼmar-E-Reyd
Jesúsʼba dulemar-atursamalad-warbo nakrusgi bioksamarmogad. Wargwen Jesús-argan-nuedsik ogwichismalad, baiddi Jesús-argan-sapiledsik.
Deyobi Bab-Dummad-Gardagi-sognaiyob ibmar gusad. A-gardagi weyob sognaid:
Isaías 53:12
Dulemar-Jesús-dikarba-nasdamalad nono-ege-ege imakdamalad, geb egi dodoar ega sogdedamalad: —Be-dule, be sunna Babse-goled-neg-earye sogsad, degi, ibapaagi be gannar sobsabalirye sogsad,
be nakrusgi-naid aidedage, na be-dukin bendake.
Deyopira dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar Jesúsʼgi dododmarmogad, sogdedamalad: —Dule-baigandi nabir bendaksad, na edi dukin geg bendaked.

Ede na sogsagusad, ani an Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duleye, Israel-dulemar-E-Reyye. Ar nabirile, nakrusgi-naidgi emisgwa aidedage, adi, anmar dakega, degi, anmar egi benguosulid. Jesúsʼba-nakrusgi-bioklegar-naimarmogad egi dodonanai gusmarmogad.
Jesús-burgwisad
Dad-yorukugusgu, bela-napneggi negsichid nagunonikid, wachi-irbaase nai gusad.
Wachi-irbaa-gusgu, Jesús binnasur-gote, sogded:
Salmo 22:1
Gwenna-gwenna-walik-bukmalad, Jesús deyob soge itosmargu, sogdemalad: —Be itomala, Elíasʼse gornaid.

Dule-wargwen abarmakded, ibmar-buta-butad vino-gagbidgi-owardikusgu, suar-dukugi edichad, geb Jesús-gobega Jesús-walikaa imaksad. Geb sogded: —Anmar dakmalo, bule Elías odenonikodibe. Degisoggu, mer ese achamalo.
Geb agi, Jesús napi-binnasur-gote, burgwided.
Geb a-wachigi, Jerusalénʼgi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-siidgi, Neg-Islidikid-irwa-mor-naid niba achirmakded, urbalidse.
Roma-suar-ibed-sordamar-dulatar-sediid (100), Jesús-asabin-gwichid, Jesús-binnasur-gote-itosgu, degi, igi-burgwis-daksagua, sogded: —Napiragwa, we-dule, nue-Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadid.
Omegan gwenna-gwenna bannaba dakbuk gusmalad. Amar-abargine María-Magdalena, Salomé, degi, María Jacobo-bipigwad-e-nan, degi, José-e-nanbalid, dakbukwa gusmarmogad.
We-omegan, Jesús-Galileaʼgi-gudidagu, gusgu Jesúsʼba gudidamarmogad, degi, ega ibmar-imakdii gusmalad. Deginbali, omegan-baigan-bukidar Jesúsʼba-Jerusalénʼse-nonigusmaladi, dakbukwa gusmarmogad.
Jesús-diglesad
Deun a-ibagi ibmar-guagwar-sied-ibad, a-sogleged, bato obunnoged-iba nagusokarye. Degisoggu, neg-sedodgu,

dule-wargwen Arimatea-neggweburgined-Joséʼye-nugad, Jesús-e-mui-egisega Pilatoʼse dobsuli nonigusad. A-dulede, Judío-igar-nabiromalad-abargi dule-nue-nug-nikadid. Deginbali, José, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid nue edarbedibalid.
Pilato, bato-Jesús-burgwisad geg-itogedba, Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediidse (100) gochasunnad. Ese egichided, Jesús bato burgwis-sogeye.
Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid, Pilatoʼga bela ibmar sogsagu, Pilato Joséʼga Jesús-mui uksasunnad.
Geb degine, José Jesús-mui-nakrusgi-naid odesad. Atued-baksadgi nue-obipirmaksad, geb akwa-gwisar-neg-uanga-siid-yaba Jesús-mesisad. Geb sorbali, neg-uan-yawagak-doged-idu akwa-dummad sisad.
María-Magdalena, degi, José-e-nan-María, bia Jesús-megisad daksamalad.
